name: Accepted budget item produces a numbered decision that approves the budget
title: SC-11-12-01 Accepted budget item produces a numbered decision that approves the budget
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given an assembly with quorum and a budget item
When the assembly votes to accept it
Then a numbered decision is recorded and approves the budget
